Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring sellers to notify buyers of land located in close proximity to land traditionally used for hunting.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing notice in real estate transactions ofproximity to lands used for public hunting; amending RCW 64.06.022; andadding a new section to chapter 77.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department may, when deemed appropriate by the director basedon local circumstances and departmental resources, partner withvolunteer organizations and real estate professionals to educatepotential real estate sellers and buyers of the location andtraditional uses of any land in proximity to a potential transactionwhere public hunting has been, is, or may be permitted.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 64.06.022 and 2006 c 77 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A seller of real property shall make available to the buyer thefollowing ((statement)) two statements regarding possible preexistingnearby land uses: p. 1 HB 2706 (1) "This notice is to inform you that the real property you areconsidering for purchase may lie in close proximity to a farm. Theoperation of a farm involves usual and customary agriculturalpractices, which are protected under RCW 7.48.305, the Washington rightto farm act"; and (2) "This notice is to inform you that the real property you areconsidering for purchase may lie in close proximity to land that hasbeen traditionally open for public hunting, an activity which mayinclude the use of firearms. Hunting is a lawful and accepted activitywhen conducted at a time and place, and in a manner, consistent withregulations adopted by the fish and wildlife commission pursuant toTitle 77 RCW."
